name: locks-in-main-test-617c6c002d/worker-send-receive-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: "- [Lock statement](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#lock-stmt)"; named worker declarations and worker send statements are absent from the supported list.

reason: The case asserts diagnostics for synchronous and asynchronous worker sends and worker receives inside locks.
